name: Check Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

  actions: read
  id-token: write

  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@4f5c3b3e55f73f4419e481ab68cdd95a1b2c3d4e
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y just

      - name: Run Zizmor
        uses: zizmorcore/zizmor-action@135698455da5c3b3e55f73f4419e481ab68cdd95
        with:
          inputs: .github/
          config: .github/zizmor.yml
          min-severity: warning
          fail-on-no-inputs: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
